situation: A call to check_in_guest has succeeded in the current run, the current run is a planned run, and the current run is a late-arrival run.
title: Conflict between manager approval and late-arrival rules
explanation: The requirements cannot all be obeyed in this situation because R1 requires that an earlier call to ask_manager was approved, while R4 forbids any call to ask_manager in a late-arrival run. This problem appears in the situation where a check-in succeeds in a run that is both planned and a late-arrival. This finding depends on the assumption that if an earlier call to ask_manager was approved, then a call to ask_manager was made in the run.
option_a: Keeping the requirements as written means that a successful check-in in a planned, late-arrival run is impossible because it would require both an approved manager request and the absence of any manager request.
option_b: Change R4 to allow calls to ask_manager in late-arrival runs, or change R1 to not require an approved manager request when the run is a late-arrival run.
